items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1994-01-15
items.q: Because Larry McKinley said he was going to come up and sit on our watch line and sell records for us, promote records and promote airplay

ctx.x: Because Larry McKinley said he was going to come up and sit on our watch line and sell records for us, promote records and promote airplay, and talk to all these jock friends around the country and all that.
Personally come and promote and talk to these disc jockey friends all over the country.
